title.zh: IPLC 跨国点对点内网专线原理全景剖析：物理不过 GFW 机制与抗主动探测特性
title.en: IPLC Point-to-Point Circuit Architecture: Physical GFW Bypass & Anti-Active-Probing Mechanisms

cluster.zh: IPLC 纯专线与全球节点集群

description.zh: 深入硬核拆解 IPLC（国际私有租用线路）在物理层、链路层与海底光缆时分复用（TDM/SDH）中的传输原理，阐明其为何物理上彻底脱离 GFW 监管范围，实现 100% 免疫主动探测阻断。
description.en: A comprehensive technical dissection of IPLC (International Private Leased Circuit) physical, data-link, and SDH/TDM transport mechanisms, detailing why it physically bypasses public GFW inspection.
